t: Totality Nutrition is a calorie and macro tracker built on Australian food data. You log what you eat, it shows calories, protein, carbs and fat against your own targets, and it keeps your history. It runs on Android and in your web browser at totalitynutrition.com.au , and the iPhone app is with Apple for review (until it's out, use the web app in Safari). Your account is the same everywhere. Home on a trial account, with today's calories, macros and Tali's tip

The two tiers # Every account is one of these: Free A$0, forever. Food logging by search with your full history, calories and macros against your targets, water, weight and Progress, the calculator, up to 10 saved meals, 7 barcode scans a week and Tell Tali what you ate 3 times a day. No ads. Paid Nutrition (A$8.99 a month) or Nutrition + AI (A$11.99 a month). Paid adds Insights, Breakdown, Meal Plan, Grocery List, Recipes, unlimited saved meals, unlimited barcode scans and Apple Health or Health Connect. Nutrition + AI also adds Tali's AI features with 100 credits a month. Every new account starts with a 7 day trial Trial of the full Nutrition plan. No card is needed. When the 7 days are up you move to Free, unless you pick a plan. Nothing is deleted. See Plans compared for the full table. Throughout this guide, badges show who gets what: Free Trial Paid .

s: Get set up in five minutes
t: Get set up in five minutes # Create your account with your name, email and a password. See Create your account . Answer five quick onboarding questions: units, goal, training days, body stats and date of birth. See Onboarding . Check the targets it works out for you and tap Get Started . Take Tali's short tour of Home. It takes under a minute. See Home and the tour . Log your first meal. Tap Log Food , then search, scan a barcode or tell Tali what you ate. See Your food log . Tali says G'day, I'm Tali. Best first step is logging what you've eaten so far today. Search it, scan it, or just tell me. No need to be perfect on day one.

Where things live # The bar along the bottom has three tabs: Tab What it is Home (house) Today's calories and macros, your streak and Quick access tiles Nutrition (apple) Your food log for the day, meal by meal Calculator Work out or redo your calorie and macro targets Everything else opens from Home: Breakdown , Meal Plan , Grocery List , Hydration , Insights and Progress are the Quick access tiles, and the gear icon at the top opens Settings . The purple ? button that floats on most screens opens Report an Issue . See Troubleshooting .

Questions # Is Totality Nutrition really free? Yes. The Free plan is A$0 with no time limit and no ads. You keep food logging, your full history, targets, water, weight, Progress, 7 barcode scans a week, up to 10 saved meals and Tell Tali 3 times a day. Do I need a card for the trial? No. The 7 day trial needs no card. If you don't pick a plan, you move to Free when it ends. Can I use it on my computer? Yes. Open totalitynutrition.com.au in any browser and log in with the same email and password. Barcode scanning by camera and wearables need the phone app; on the web you can type a barcode number instead. I already use Totality with my trainer. Do I need a new account? No. Log in with your Totality email and password. See Using Nutrition with a Totality trainer .

t: You can sign up in the app or on the web. Both give you the same account. Create your account Log in

Sign up # Open the app, or go to totalitynutrition.com.au, and tap Sign up at the bottom of the log in screen. Enter your First name (required) and Last name (optional). Enter your Email address . Choose a Password : at least 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase, and a number or symbol. Type it again in Confirm password . The eye icon shows or hides what you typed. If a friend gave you a code, type it into Referral code . If you opened a friend's share link, the code is already filled in and shows "Referral code applied". Tap Change to use a different one. Tap Create Account . You go straight into onboarding, and a welcome email is sent to you. Good to know The Referral code box doesn't show in the iPhone app, because referral discounts apply to web and Android billing only. Use the web or Android app to sign up with a code.

Accept the terms # The first time you sign in, the Terms & Conditions sheet appears. Read the key points, tick the box to confirm you've read them and that you are 18 or older, then tap Accept & Continue . Tap Read the full Terms & Conditions to see the full version. The sheet keeps coming back until you accept, even if you close the app. The terms sheet shows once, until you accept

Log in # Enter your Email address and Password , then tap Log In . If you see "Please confirm your email address before logging in", open the confirmation email we sent and tap the link, then try again.

Forgot your password # On the log in screen, tap Forgot Password? Enter your email address and tap Send Reset Link . Open the email and tap the link. It opens a page where you choose a new password. Log in with the new password. Reset Password

Questions # It says an account with this email already exists. You've already signed up, possibly in Totality. Tap Log in instead. If you've forgotten the password, use Forgot Password? Why does it say my password needs a mix of characters? Passwords need at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and a number or symbol. Can I add a referral code after I've signed up? The box is only on the sign up screen. If you missed it, email admintotality@gmail.com. The reset email hasn't arrived. Check your junk folder, and check you typed the same email you signed up with. You can send another link from Forgot Password?

t: Onboarding runs once, straight after you sign up (or the first time a Totality member opens Nutrition). It takes about two minutes and ends with your calorie and macro targets. The bar at the top shows Step 1 of 5 and so on. Back takes you to the step before, and nothing is saved until the last step.

Step 1: units # "Let's set up your units" guesses your country from your phone and shows a summary, for example "Looks like you're in Australia, English (Australia) · kg · cm · kcal". Pick your Body weight (kg, lb or st lb), Height (cm or ft in) and Energy (kcal or kJ). Tap Water, distance, country and dates for the rest: Water (ml or fl oz), Distance (km or miles), Week starts on (Monday, Sunday or Saturday), Time (12 hour or 24 hour), Country and Language . Picking a country sets that country's usual units. When it looks right, tap Looks right, next . Step 1, the main units Step 1, with the extra options open You can change all of these later in Settings , Units and region . See Units and region .
Step 2: your goal # "What's your primary goal?" Pick one: Lose Weight , Build Muscle , Improve Fitness or General Health , then tap Next .
Step 3: how active you are # "How many days per week do you train?" Tap a number from 1 to 7 , then Next . Step 2, your goal Step 3, training days

Step 4: body stats # Pick your Biological sex : Male or Female . If you pick Female, answer Are you pregnant or breastfeeding? with No , Pregnant: 1st trimester (weeks 1 to 13), Pregnant: 2nd trimester (weeks 14 to 27), Pregnant: 3rd trimester (weeks 28+) or Breastfeeding (based on exclusive breastfeeding). Type your Current weight and Goal weight in the unit you chose. Stone users get two boxes (st and lb), and ft in users get two boxes for height. Type your Height . Tap Select date and pick your Date of birth from the calendar. The double arrows jump a year at a time. Tap Next . Step 4, sex and pregnancy question Step 4, filled in The app checks the numbers make sense: weight between 20 and 300 kg (or the same in your unit), height between 100 and 250 cm, and an age between 13 and 100. If something is off you'll see a message like "Check your weight".

Step 5: your targets # "Your targets" shows your daily calories (or kJ) and grams of protein, carbs and fat. Under it is the "Your first 7 days are on us" card, which explains the trial. Tap Get Started to save. Step 5, your targets The trial note under your targets When you tap Get Started the app saves your answers, saves these targets as your current targets, saves your units, and takes you to Home where Tali's tour starts. How the numbers are worked out, including pregnancy and breastfeeding, is on Your targets .

Questions # Can I skip onboarding? No. The app needs your goal and body stats to set your targets, so it opens onboarding until it's done. I made a mistake in onboarding. How do I fix it? Use the Calculator tab to work your targets out again, or Settings , Custom Targets to type your own. Units are in Settings , Units and region . Does my 7 day trial start now? Yes. Your trial starts at your first Nutrition onboarding. Settings , Subscription shows how many days are left. Why does it ask for biological sex? The calorie formula (Mifflin-St Jeor) uses a different number for male and female bodies. It's only used to work out your targets.

t: Your targets are the daily calories (or kJ) and grams of protein, carbs and fat that Home and your food log measure you against. They're set in onboarding and you can change them any time. Targets work the same on Free , Trial and Paid .

s: How the numbers are worked out
t: How the numbers are worked out # The app uses the Mifflin-St Jeor formula. BMR (what your body burns at rest) comes from your weight, height, age and sex. TDEE (what you burn in a day) is your BMR multiplied up for activity. In onboarding this uses your training days plus a moderate amount of daily walking. In the Calculator you also choose your Daily steps . Your goal adjusts it. Lose Weight takes off 500 calories a day, Build Muscle adds 300, and Improve Fitness and General Health stay at maintenance. Targets never go below 1,200 calories. Protein is set per kilo of body weight: 2.2 g/kg to lose weight, 2.0 g/kg to build muscle and 1.8 g/kg otherwise. Fat is 25% of your calories, and carbs fill the rest. The app suggests you adjust based on how your body responds over 2 to 3 weeks.

Pregnancy and breastfeeding # If you choose a pregnancy or breastfeeding option, the targets change to suit: Option What changes Pregnant: 1st trimester Maintenance calories, no extra energy yet Pregnant: 2nd trimester Maintenance plus about 335 calories a day Pregnant: 3rd trimester Maintenance plus about 455 calories a day Breastfeeding Maintenance plus about 480 calories and 21 g protein a day There is no calorie deficit while pregnant or breastfeeding, so Lose Weight is treated as maintenance. While pregnant there is no muscle gain surplus either. Breastfeeding can use Maintain or Muscle Gain in the Calculator, never Fat Loss. Your results lead with protein ("YOUR MAIN FOCUS: PROTEIN"), and the calorie number is shown as a minimum , not a limit. Home and the food log then say "to go" and "Minimum reached" instead of "remaining" and "over". Calorie Cycling and Adaptive Nutrition are switched off for these targets, because both create days below target. Step 5 with Pregnant: 2nd trimester chosen Good to know These adjustments follow general Australian guidelines (NHMRC). Every pregnancy is different, so check your targets with your GP, obstetrician, midwife or dietitian.

Recalculate with the Calculator # The Calculator tab (the calculator icon on the bottom bar), also reached from Settings , Recalculate Targets , works your targets out again. It fills in your sex, latest weight, height, age and training days from what you've already told the app. Check Biological sex , and the pregnancy question if it shows. Check Weight , Height and Age . Pick Gym sessions / week (0 to 7) and Daily steps (Under 5k, 5-10k, 10-20k or 20k+). Pick a Goal : Fat Loss , Maintain or Muscle Gain . For Fat Loss or Muscle Gain, also pick a Pace . Fat Loss takes off 250, 500 or 750 calories; Muscle Gain adds 150, 300 or 500. Pick a Diet : Balanced , High Carb (20% fat), High Fat (35% fat) or High Protein (an extra 0.3 g/kg protein). Tap Calculate . You see your BMR, TDEE, target and recommended macros. Tap Save My Targets . The Calculator Results, ready to save Saving makes these your current targets straight away. Your food log measures every day you look at against your current targets.

Type your own targets # Settings , Custom Targets lets you type Daily calories (or daily energy in kJ), Protein (g) , Carbs (g) and Fat (g) yourself, then Save Targets . This replaces whatever target is currently active. Protein, carbs and fat need at least 1 g each. Custom Targets

Calorie cycling # Calorie cycling gives you more on training days and less on rest days, with the same weekly total. Find it in Settings , CALORIE CYCLING . Turn on Enable Calorie Cycling . Tap your Training Days . Pick a Training Day Adjustment : +100 to +500 calories. Check the Preview : training day, rest day and weekly total. Tap Save Cycling Settings . Calorie cycling with Mon, Wed and Fri as training days Your food log then shows a Training day or Rest day badge under the date.

Adaptive Nutrition # With Enable Adaptive Nutrition on (then Save Adaptive Nutrition ), the app checks every night whether you went over your calorie target the day before. If you did, today's target drops to make up for it, by up to 500 calories a day, with any leftover carried to the next day. It never drops below a 1,200 calorie floor. Protein stays fixed and carbs and fat shrink. Home shows an Adjusted badge on those days. Calorie cycling and Adaptive Nutrition can't both be on. Turning one on turns the other off.

Questions # My trainer sets my targets in Totality. Which ones does Nutrition use? The most recent targets, whoever set them. If you save new ones in the Calculator or Custom Targets, those become your current targets. See Using Nutrition with a Totality trainer . Why is my calorie number shown as a minimum? Your targets are set for pregnancy or breastfeeding. The aim is to eat at least that much. Can I use kJ instead of calories? Yes. Change Energy to kJ in Settings , Units and region . Everything is shown and typed in kJ. Why can't I turn on Calorie Cycling? It's switched off while your targets are set for pregnancy or breastfeeding, since rest days would drop below your minimum. Save non-pregnancy targets in the Calculator first if that no longer applies.

t: Units change how numbers are shown and how the numbers you type are read. They're the same on Free , Trial and Paid . You first choose them in onboarding; change them any time in Settings , Units and region . Units and region

Change your units # On Home, tap the gear icon to open Settings . Under UNITS AND REGION , tap Units and region . Tap the option you want. Each change saves straight away and a short message confirms it. Setting Options Body weight kg, lb, st lb Height and measurements cm, ft in (tape measurements show in inches) Energy kcal, kJ Water ml, fl oz Distance km, miles Week starts on Monday, Sunday, Saturday Time 12 hour, 24 hour Under REGION , pick your Country and Language (the English you prefer). The button below them reads Use Australia's usual units (or your country's), and changes to Using Australia's usual units once they match. Looks like shows today's date and time in your chosen style. Good to know Food serving sizes stay in grams or ml, as you enter them. Everything is saved in metric behind the scenes, so switching units never changes your history.

What changes where # kJ shows energy in kJ on Home, the food log, Add food, Breakdown, Insights and the Calculator, and you type kJ in edit boxes. lb or st lb changes weight entry in Progress, Measures and the Calculator. Stone users log a weight change in pounds, and the weight chart is in lb. fl oz changes water amounts and your water target. Tali writes her sentences in your units and your English.

Questions # If I switch from kg to lb, will my weight history change? No. It's stored in kg and simply shown in lb. Do these settings carry over to Totality? Units are saved on your account, so the Nutrition onboarding starts from the units you already confirmed in Totality. Why does the meal plan week still start on Monday? The meal plan and grocery weeks always run Monday to Sunday. Your week start setting changes calendars and date displays.

t: Home is the first screen you see. It shows today at a glance and gets you to everything else. Home on a trial account Lower down: streak and Quick access

The tour # The first time you reach Home after onboarding, Tali walks you through it in 8 short steps: the calories card, telling Tali what you ate, your streak, Quick access, the Nutrition tab and the Calculator tab. A ring highlights each part. Tap Next to move on, Back to go back, or Skip tour at the top right. Step 1 of 8 Step 3 of 8, Tell Tali At the end you see "You're all set!" with three first jobs, then the option to Add a Profile Photo . Tap Choose Photo and Save Photo , or Skip for now . The tour only shows once.

What's on Home # Top bar. A greeting with your first name and today's date. The gear icon opens Settings , and Log Food opens your food log. Calories card. "CALORIES TODAY" (or KJ TODAY) shows what you've eaten, what's left (or how much you're over, in red), and your target. Below are protein, carbs and fat against their targets. A Training day badge shows on calorie cycling training days, and an Adjusted badge when Adaptive Nutrition has lowered today's target. Tali row. Inside the calories card. Tap Tell Tali what you ate to describe a meal in plain words. On Trial and Nutrition + AI Paid it also shows Tali's protein tip, for example "49g protein to go. About 17g at each of your next 3 meals gets you there." On Free it reads "Describe it in plain words and Tali logs it." It picks breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack from the time of day. Connect a wearable. Shows today's steps, heart rate and sleep once a wearable is connected. Until then it prompts you to connect one. See Apple Health and Health Connect . Logging Streak. Your streak in days and the last 7 days as dots. Tap it to see your badges. See Streaks . Quick access. Six tiles: Breakdown , Meal Plan , Grocery List , Hydration

Home on Free # On Free , a "You're on Free" card shows how many of your 7 barcode scans are left this week, with a See plans button. Breakdown, Meal Plan, Grocery List and Insights show a small padlock. Tapping a locked tile opens the plans screen. Hydration and Progress stay open. Free: scans left and locked tiles Free: top of Home

Before you have targets # If you have no targets yet, the calories card isn't shown. You'll see a Tell Tali what you ate card instead. Set targets in the Calculator tab. Home with no targets or logs yet

Questions # Can I see the tour again? Not from the app. It shows once, after your first onboarding. This guide covers everything it does. Why is my calorie bar red? You've gone over today's target. On pregnancy or breastfeeding targets it never turns red; it says "Minimum reached". Where did Settings go? It's the gear icon at the top of Home, next to Log Food . Why don't I see Tali's protein tip? The tip shows on the trial and on Nutrition + AI. On Free and on the Nutrition plan the row still lets you tell Tali what you ate.

t: The food log is the Nutrition tab (the apple icon on the bottom bar), or Log Food on Home. It shows one day at a time, split into meals, with totals at the top. It works the same on Free , Trial and Paid , and keeps your full history. The food log for today Lower down: snacks, Saved Meals and Recipes

Read the day # The card at the top shows calories eaten , what's remaining (or over , in red) and your target. Bars show protein, carbs and fat against their targets. A bar turns red if you go over that macro. If calorie cycling is on, a Training day or Rest day badge sits under the date. Each meal shows its own calories, protein, carbs and fat, then each food with its serving and P, C and F grams on the right.
Move between days # Tap the arrows either side of the date. You can go up to 7 days back and 7 days ahead of today. The date reads Today , Yesterday or Tomorrow , or the date itself.
Add food to a meal # Tap the blue + on a meal, or Tap to add food under an empty meal. This opens Add food for that meal and day. See Add food .

Meals and snacks # Every day starts with Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner and Snack . Add Another Snack adds Snack 2, then Snack 3, up to Snack 5. The up and down arrows on a meal move it up or down the day. The order is saved for that day. The star on a meal saves it as a saved meal. See Saved meals .
Planned food # Food added from your Meal Plan shows in the log with a Planned · mark as eaten tag. Tap the tag once you've eaten it. Planned food for a future day shows Planned until that day.
Saved Meals and Recipes buttons # Below the meals, Saved Meals opens your saved meals and Recipes opens My Recipes, both set to the day you're looking at. Recipes are Paid .

Questions # Can I log food for last week? You can move up to 7 days back from the Food Log date arrows. Everything you've logged stays in your history. Can I log tomorrow's food now? Yes, up to 7 days ahead. It counts on that day. Do planned foods count before I mark them eaten? Yes. They're in your log for that day as soon as they're planned, so they count in your totals. Marking them eaten just confirms you had them. How do I change or remove a food? Tap the food to edit it, or tap the red bin to delete it. See Editing, deleting and copying .

t: Add food is where you search for a food and add it to a meal. It opens from the + on any meal in your food log. Search, favourites, recent foods and manual entry are the same on Free , Trial and Paid . Add to Lunch, with favourites and recent foods

The top row # Search foods... box. The blue phone icon scans a barcode. See Barcode scanning . The star opens your saved meals. The gear opens the Brand filter. Under it, Describe your meal to Tali opens Tell Tali. See Tell Tali what you ate .

Search for a food # Type a food, for example "chicken". Results appear as you type. Each result shows its name, brand, where the data comes from ( AFCD , USDA , Open Food Facts or User added ), and calories, protein, carbs and fat per 100 g. On the right is its usual serving, like "150g, 1 breast". Tap the food you want. Search results The Brand filter Australian foods from the AFCD (the Australian Food Composition Database) and other government data come first, then packaged foods from Open Food Facts . Foods you've logged recently rank higher. To narrow by brand, tap the gear and pick a brand, or All . Clear filter removes it.

Choose your serving # Check the Per 100g card. Under SERVING SIZE , pick a unit: g , ml , oz , or serve when the food has a known serving, for example "serve (150g)". Type the amount, or tap a quick size: 50g, 100g, 150g or 200g (or 1, 2, 4 or 6 oz). Your serving shows the calories, protein, carbs and fat for that amount. Tap Add to Lunch (or whichever meal). Choosing a serving Editing the per 100g numbers A green banner confirms it's added and you stay on the screen to add more. If a product has no serving size on its label, it starts at 100g and tells you so.

Fix wrong label numbers # If a food's numbers look wrong, tap Edit on the Per 100g card and type the numbers from the label. Your serving updates as you type. Tap Done when finished. Per 100g numbers over 900 calories, or over 100 g of protein, carbs or fat, are refused with "Per 100g numbers look too high - check the label."

Favourites and recent foods # With the search box empty, the list shows Favourites and recent foods . Tap the star on any food row to make it a favourite. Favourites stay at the top. Tap the star again to remove it. Recent foods are the foods you've logged lately. Favourites are kept on the device you starred them on, so a favourite on your phone won't show on the web. You can keep up to 40.

Manual entry # For food that isn't in the database, tap Manual entry (or Enter Manually when a search finds nothing). Type a Food Name , for example "Homemade stir fry". Type the Serving Size (grams) . Type Calories (or Energy (kJ) ), Protein (g) , Carbs (g) and Fat (g) . Fibre (g), optional is there too. Tap Add to Lunch . Manual Entry

Questions # Why can't I find a food? Try a simpler word ("bread" instead of "sourdough"), the brand name, or scan the barcode. If it's still not there, use Manual entry . What does "User added" mean? The food came from a barcode scan or a packaged food someone else logged. It's shared so the next person finds it faster. Is there a limit on how much I can enter? One entry can't be more than 5000 g, 10,000 calories, or 1000 g of protein, carbs or fat. This stops typos wrecking your totals. My favourites disappeared. Favourites live on the device. If you cleared the app's data, reinstalled, or are on a different phone or browser, star them again.

s: Why can't I find a food?
Is there a limit on how much I can enter?

t: Scanning a barcode finds a packaged food without typing. Barcode scanning is Free 7 a week, unlimited on Trial and Paid .

Scan a barcode # Open your food log and tap + on a meal. Tap the blue phone icon next to the search box. The first time, allow camera access. Hold the barcode inside the frame. When it reads, you'll see "Barcode scanned!". The food opens with a Scanned from barcode tag. Check the Per 100g numbers, choose your serving and tap Add to your meal. If the camera won't pick it up, tap Enter barcode manually , type the number printed under the barcode (for example 9300650044867) and tap Search . On the web: type the barcode number Good to know Live camera scanning works in the phone apps. In a web browser that can't scan, you'll see "Enter Barcode" and can type the number instead.

s: Where the food data comes from
t: Where the food data comes from # The app checks its own food list first (foods other people have already scanned and saved), then Open Food Facts. If a product's label has no serving size, it starts at 100g and tells you so. If the numbers look wrong, tap Edit on the Per 100g card and copy them from the label.

Scans on Free # Free accounts get 7 barcode scans a week . The week runs Monday to Sunday, Sydney time, and resets on Monday. The scan icon shows a small number: the scans you have left this week. Home shows "4 of 7 barcode scans left this week" on the "You're on Free" card. A scan counts when the scanner reads a barcode (or you search a typed number), even if the product isn't found. When you've used all 7, tapping the scan icon shows "That's your 7 scans for this week". Tap See plans to look at Nutrition, or Search by name instead . Searching by name is always unlimited. Free: 4 scans left on the scan icon All 7 used this week

Questions # It says "No food found for barcode". That product isn't in our list or in Open Food Facts yet. Search by name, or use Manual entry . Once you log it, it helps the next person. Did a failed scan use one of my 7? Yes. On Free a scan counts as soon as a barcode is read, found or not. When do my scans reset? Monday at midnight, Sydney time. The camera shows "Camera Permission Required". You said no to camera access. Allow the camera for Totality Nutrition in your phone's settings, then try again, or type the barcode number.

s: It says "No food found for barcode".
Did a failed scan use one of my 7?

t: A saved meal is a group of foods you eat often, like "My usual breakfast". Log it again in one tap instead of adding each food. Saved meals are Free up to 10, unlimited on Trial and Paid .

Save a meal # Log the foods in your food log as normal. Tap the star on that meal's header (next to the + ). The star only shows once the meal has food in it. Give it a name in Save Meal , for example "Post gym shake". Tap Save . You'll see "Saved! ... Find it under Saved Meals." Save Meal

Log a saved meal # Open Saved Meals : the star next to the search box in Add food, or the Saved Meals button at the bottom of your food log. Each card shows the meal name, how many items, total calories and the foods in it. Tap Log this meal . If you came from a meal's + , it goes straight into that meal. Otherwise Add to which meal? asks: Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner or Snack . Saved Meals Add to which meal? To delete a saved meal, tap the bin on its card and confirm. Logging it never changes the saved meal itself.

Saved meals on Free # Free keeps up to 10 saved meals . When you have 10 and try to save another, you'll see "Saved meals are full". Delete one you don't use, or move to Nutrition for unlimited saved meals. Your existing saved meals always keep working. No saved meals yet

Questions # Can I edit a saved meal? Not directly. Log it, change the foods in your food log, save the meal again with the star, and delete the old one. My saved meals show in Totality too. Yes. Saved meals are on your account, so they're shared with the Totality app if you use it with a trainer. What happens to my saved meals if I go from a paid plan to Free? They all stay and still log. You just can't save a new one while you have 10 or more. Are saved meals the same as favourites? No. A favourite is a single food starred in Add food. A saved meal is a whole group of foods.

t: Instead of searching for each food, type what you ate the way you'd say it, like "2 eggs on sourdough with butter and a flat white". Tali splits it into foods and amounts, matches each one to the food database, and you check it before anything is logged. Telling Tali never uses credits, but there's a daily limit: Plan Meals described per day Free 3 Nutrition Paid 3 Trial 5 Nutrition + AI Paid 50 The day resets at midnight, Sydney time.

Describe a meal # Tap Tell Tali what you ate on Home, or Describe your meal to Tali in Add food. Pick the meal: Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner or Snack . Type what you ate, up to 500 characters. With the box empty you can tap one of the "Try:" examples. Tap Ask Tali . The button shows how many you have left today, for example "48 left today". Describe your meal On Free: 2 left today

Check and log # Tali shows each food with the amount in grams. The calories and macros always come from the food database, never from the AI. Tap a food's name to pick a different match from the list, or type in the search box under it and tap Search . Change the grams in the box on the right. Tap the x to remove a food. "check the amount" means Tali wasn't sure of the portion. TOTAL shows the whole meal. Tap Log 4 foods to Breakfast (the number and meal match yours). You go back to your food log. Tap Describe it differently to start again. Check each food Total and the Log button If a food shows "No match, tap to choose" or has no amount, it won't be logged. A red note tells you how many will be skipped. Tali says Type it how you'd say it to a mate. "Big bowl of spag bol and a Coke Zero" works fine. I'll have a crack at the portions, you just check them.

Questions # I've hit today's limit. You'll see "You've reached today's limit of 3 meals described to Tali." Search or scan as normal, or come back tomorrow. Nutrition + AI allows 50 a day. Does describing a meal use my AI credits? No. It's counted separately with the daily limit above. Tali picked the wrong food. Tap the food name and choose another match, or search for the right one in the box under it. Can Tali see my photos or voice? No. Tell Tali works from what you type.

s: Does describing a meal use my AI credits?
Can Tali see my photos or voice?

t: You can fix anything in your food log. All of this works on Free , Trial and Paid .

Edit a logged food # In your food log, tap the food. Change the Serving size . Calories, protein, carbs and fat update to match. Or type corrected Calories (or Energy (kJ) ), Protein (g) , Carbs (g) and Fat (g) directly. Tap Save , or Cancel to leave it. Edit a logged food Changing the serving also scales fibre, sugar, sodium, saturated fat and vitamins and minerals for that entry.
Delete a food # Tap the red bin on the right of the food. Tap the red tick to confirm, or the grey x to keep it. Confirm the delete

Copy yesterday # Copy Yesterday at the top of the food log copies everything you logged yesterday into today, in the same meals. It only shows while you're looking at today. If today already has food, you're asked whether to Add anyway (on top of what's there) or Cancel . If yesterday is empty, you'll see "Nothing to copy". When it works you'll see how many entries were copied.
Change a meal's order # Use the up and down arrows on a meal's header to move it. The order is saved for that day.

Questions # Can I undo a delete? No. Add the food again from Add food; it will be in your recent foods. Can I copy a day other than yesterday? No. Copy Yesterday only copies yesterday into today. Saved meals are the way to repeat any meal. Can I move a food to a different meal? Not directly. Delete it and add it to the other meal. It will be at the top of your recent foods.

s: Can I copy a day other than yesterday?
Can I move a food to a different meal?

t: Hydration tracks your water against a daily target. It's on Free , Trial and Paid . Open it from the Hydration tile on Home. Today's water Last 7 days and today's entries

Log water # Open Hydration . Tap + 250 ml , + 500 ml or + 750 ml . For another amount, type it in Custom amount (ml) and tap Add . The day card shows your total, your target, a percentage and how much is left ("1.25 L to go"). Once you reach it you'll see "Target reached. Nice work."

Look at other days # Use the arrows beside the date, or tap a bar in Last 7 days . Each bar is one day in litres; the dashed line is your target, and darker bars are days you hit it. The entries list below shows that day's drinks with the time. Tap the bin on an entry to delete it.
Set your target # Tap the pencil at the top right. In Daily Water Target , type your goal and tap Save Target . The default is 2,500 ml (2.5 L).

Questions # Can I log water in fl oz? Yes. Set Water to fl oz in Settings , Units and region . The buttons and target then use fl oz. I use Totality with my trainer. Is my water shared? Yes. Water logged in either app shows in both, with the same target. Does water count toward my calories? No. Water is tracked on its own.

s: Can I log water in fl oz?
I use Totality with my trainer. Is my water shared?
Does water count toward my calories?

t: Progress has three tabs: Photos , Measures and Weight . It's on Free , Trial and Paid . Open it from the Progress tile on Home.

Log your weight # Open Progress and tap Weight . Tap + Log Weight . Leave it on Absolute and type today's weight. Stone users get boxes for st and lb. Or switch to Change to log a change since your last weight, for example +0.7 or -0.5, using the quick 0.5 buttons if you like. "Will be logged as" shows the result. Tap Save . Weight trend and your numbers Weight Log You can log more than once a day; each is its own entry. The WEIGHT TREND chart shows each weigh-in and a 7-day trend line once you have at least two. Under it, Current , Start and Change sum up your progress. To delete an entry, tap the red x in the Weight Log and confirm.

Body measurements # Tap Measures , then + Add Measurement . Fill in any of Weight , Chest , Waist , Hips , Left Arm , Right Arm , Left Thigh and Right Thigh , plus optional Notes . Tap Save . Measurement History lists each set by date, newest first. Tap the red x to delete one. Tape measurements are in cm or inches, depending on your units.
Progress photos # Tap Photos , then Front , Side or Back under Add Progress Photo , and pick a photo. It's saved with the date in Photo History . Measurement History Add Progress Photo

Questions # Do I need to log weight every day? No, but the 7-day trend line is smoother with regular weigh-ins. Same time of day, same conditions, works best. Who can see my progress photos? You. If you also use Totality with a trainer, your trainer can see your weight, measurements and progress photos in Totality. Does my weight change my targets? Not by itself. The Calculator fills in your latest weight next time you open it, so tap Calculate and Save My Targets when you want new targets.

s: Do I need to log weight every day?
Who can see my progress photos?
Does my weight change my targets?

t: Two screens help you understand what you're eating. Both are Trial and Paid . On Free their tiles on Home show a padlock and open a "part of Nutrition" screen with See plans and Not now . Insights on Free Breakdown on Free

Trend Insights # Open Insights from Home. From top to bottom: 7-Day Average. Your average calories, protein, carbs and fat over today and the 6 days before, counting only days you logged, and how far that is from your target. It shows once you've logged 2 or more days. Tali's weekly summary. "Want me to sum up last week (Monday to Sunday)?" Tap Get my weekly summary (uses 1 credit). See below. Insights for the last 14 days. Cards that point out patterns, for example "Calorie intake looks consistent", "Consistently under calorie target", "Protein consistently under target", "Hitting protein target every day" or "Weekend sodium spike". Insights on Nutrition + AI, with a saved weekly summary Insight cards Insights need at least 4 days of logging in the last 14 days. Before that you'll see how many days you've logged so far. If you haven't set targets, you'll be asked to set them in the Calculator first. Insights are pattern observations from your own logged data, not medical advice.

Tali's weekly summary # Tali writes a short summary of last week (Monday to Sunday, Sydney time): a headline, a few sentences and tips. It costs 1 credit . Once written it's saved, so opening it again is free. Write a fresh one · uses 1 credit writes it again. You need at least 3 days logged that week. Weekly summaries use AI credits: Trial 10 credits for the whole trial, Nutrition + AI Paid 100 a month. The Nutrition plan has no AI credits, so it shows "Part of Nutrition + AI". See Tali AI . Trial account: weekly summary not written yet

Breakdown # Nutrition Breakdown shows everything you ate on one day, added up. Open it from the Breakdown tile. Use the arrows to change the day. CALORIES & MACROS. Calories, protein, carbs and fat against your targets, with a percentage. FIBRE, SUGAR, FAT & SALT. Fibre, sugars, saturated fat and sodium against label Daily Intake values. Sugars, saturated fat and sodium are limits, so the bar reads "of limit". VITAMINS and MINERALS. Each against the adult RDI used on Australian food labels. Calories and macros Vitamins Good to know Each total only counts foods that list that nutrient. Australian database (AFCD) foods list calcium, iron, potassium, vitamin C and cholesterol, and scanned products list whatever their label declares. "None of these foods list this" means none of that day's foods had data for it, not that you had none.

Questions # Why does Insights say I need more days? It needs at least 4 logged days in the last 14 to find patterns. Why are some vitamins at 0? The foods you logged don't list that nutrient. Manual entries and most packaged foods only list the basics. Can I see Insights on the Nutrition plan? Yes. Insights and Breakdown are on both paid plans. Only Tali's weekly summary needs Nutrition + AI. Is this medical advice? No. It's a summary of what you logged. Talk to your GP or a dietitian about your health.

s: Why does Insights say I need more days?
Can I see Insights on the Nutrition plan?

t: Your streak counts how many days in a row you've logged food. Streaks are on Free , Trial and Paid .

How a day counts # A day counts when you log at least one food. If you haven't logged yet today, the streak still shows, counted from yesterday, with "Log today to keep your 12 day streak". Streak freeze: one missed day per Monday to Sunday week is forgiven, as long as you logged the days either side of it. A frozen day shows a blue snowflake. It doesn't add to your count. The Logging Streak card on Home shows your streak and the last 7 days. The flame changes colour as your streak grows.

Badges # Tap the streak card to open Streak badges . It shows your Best streak and Current streak , how many days to your next badge, and every badge: 7 , 14 , 30 , 60 , 100 , 200 and 365 day streaks. Earned badges show the date you earned them; the rest say "Reach 60 days" and so on. Streak badges When you hit a milestone, Tali celebrates with a full screen "7 day streak!" and Keep going .

The 7:30pm reminder # On your phone, if you have a streak of 2 or more days and haven't logged by 7:30pm, you get a reminder. The app asks for notification permission once you have a streak worth keeping. Turn it off in Settings , Streak reminder at 7:30pm . There's no reminder on the web.
Milestone emails # When you reach a milestone you also get a celebration email the next morning.

Questions # I logged yesterday but my streak reset. Check you didn't miss two days, or two days in the same week. One single missed day a week is forgiven only when both days around it are logged. Does water or weight count for my streak? No. Only food logged in your food log. Do planned meals count? Yes. Food added from your Meal Plan is in your food log for that day, so it counts.

s: I logged yesterday but my streak reset.
Does water or weight count for my streak?

t: Connect your phone's health data to see today's steps, heart rate, sleep and active calories on Home. Apple Health and Health Connect are Trial and Paid . On Free the Wearables screen shows a "part of Nutrition" screen with See plans . Wearables On Free

Connect on iPhone: Apple Health # Open the Totality Nutrition app on your iPhone. Go to Settings (gear on Home), then Connect a wearable . Or tap the Connect a wearable card on Home. Under Apple Health , tap Connect . Allow access in the Health permission prompt. You'll see "Apple Health is now connected."

Connect on Android: Health Connect # Open the Totality Nutrition app on your Android phone. Go to Settings , then Connect a wearable . Under Health Connect , tap Connect . If asked, install or update Health Connect from the Google Play Store. It's built into Android 14 and newer. Allow access to steps, heart rate and sleep in the Health Connect prompt. Health Connect brings in data from your Android phone or watch, including Samsung, Fitbit, Garmin and Pixel Watch, as long as they write to Health Connect.

What shows on Home # The wearable card shows steps , heart rate in bpm , hrs sleep and burned (active calories), with "Today", "No sync yet today" or "Not synced yet". Tap the x on the "Connect a wearable" card to hide it.
On the web # Wearables can only be connected from the phone app, not the website. If one is already connected on your phone, its data still shows on the web.

Questions # Can I connect both Apple Health and something else? Only one connection at a time. I use Totality too. Do I connect twice? No. The connection is on your account, so connecting in one app shows in the other. Does it add my exercise calories to my target? No. Steps, heart rate, sleep and burned calories are shown for information. Your targets don't change. How do I disconnect? Open Connect a wearable in Settings and tap Disconnect on the connected one.

s: Can I connect both Apple Health and something else?
I use Totality too. Do I connect twice?
Does it add my exercise calories to my target?

t: The Meal Plan lets you plan a week of meals ahead. Anything you plan is also added to your food log for that day. Meal Plan is Trial and Paid . Let Tali plan your days also needs AI credits: Trial or Nutrition + AI Paid . On Free the tile shows a padlock and opens "Meal planning is on the Nutrition plan". The week, Monday to Sunday On Free

Find your way around # The arrows beside the dates move a week back or forward. Weeks run Monday to Sunday. The day tabs ( Mon to Sun ) pick a day. A dot means that day has food planned. Each day has Breakfast , Lunch , Dinner and Snack , with calories per meal. The screen has a BETA tag while it's still being polished.

Add food to a day # Pick the day. Tap Add food under the meal. Choose Saved Meals to add a whole saved meal, or Search Foods to search for any food (type at least 2 characters). For a searched food, set the Serving size (g) . "Your serving" shows the numbers. Tap Add to Breakfast (or whichever meal). Add to Breakfast: Saved Meals or Search Foods Foods added to your plan are also logged to your Food Log for that day, with a Planned · mark as eaten tag. They count in that day's totals straight away.
Remove a planned food # Tap the bin next to it and confirm. It's also removed from your food log for that day.

Let Tali plan your days # Tali can build the plan for you from your own saved meals, recipes and the foods you usually eat, balanced to your targets. It costs 5 credits . Tap Let Tali plan your days . Under Which days? choose Whole week , or From the day you've selected to the end of the week. Optionally, tell Tali anything in Anything Tali should know? , for example "no fish, quick lunches, oats most mornings". Tap Let Tali cook . Check each day's foods and totals against your targets. Tap Change to go back and adjust. Tap Add to my plan . Let Tali plan Every number in Tali's plan is worked out from your food data, not made up by the AI. You need targets set first. If Tali can't build a plan, your credits are given back.

Questions # Why is the food from my plan already in my food log? Planning adds it to your log for that day so your totals are ready. Tap Planned · mark as eaten once you've had it, or delete it if plans change. Can I plan more than one week? Yes. Use the arrows to move to next week and add to it. What happens to my plan if I move to Free? Food already planned stays in your food log. The Meal Plan screen itself is locked on Free. Does Tali's plan replace food I've already planned? No. It's added on top. Remove anything you don't want with the bin.

t: The Grocery List turns your Meal Plan into a shopping list. It's Trial and Paid . On Free the tile is locked. Grocery List, grouped by aisle Further down, with an extra item

How the list is built # Every food in your Meal Plan for the chosen days is added up, grouped by supermarket aisle (fruit and veg, bakery, meat and seafood, dairy and eggs, pantry, snacks, drinks, frozen, other), with duplicates merged. Amounts are friendly ("13 eggs", "1.8 L", "about 450 g"), and cooked weights like rice are converted to what you buy ("converted from cooked weight"). Pick which days to shop for with the chips at the top: This week , Rest of week , Next 3 days or Next 7 days . With This week the arrows move week by week.

While you shop # Tap an item to tick it off. Ticked items drop to the bottom of their aisle, and the bar shows "1 of 11 got". Untick all clears every tick. Clear ticked removes ticked items from the list (you'll be asked to confirm). Press and hold an item, or tap its three dots, for more: Always in my pantry , Search Woolworths , Search Coles or Remove from list . Item menu Items you mark Always in my pantry move to a collapsed In your pantry section, so you're not told to buy salt every week. Removed items can be brought back with Show removed items again .
Add extra items # Tap + at the top, search for a food, set How much do you need? (g) and tap Add to List . Extra items show "added by you".
Share the list # Tap the share icon at the top right. The list is shared as text, grouped by aisle, with only the items you haven't ticked.

Questions # My grocery list is empty. It's built from your Meal Plan. Add foods to your plan first, or tap Go to Meal Plan . Do ticks save if I close the app? Yes. Ticks, removals and pantry items are saved to your account. Can I share it with my partner? Yes. Tap the share icon and send it by message, email or any app on your phone.

s: Do ticks save if I close the app?
Can I share it with my partner?

t: My Recipes holds recipes you've imported. Each one is broken into ingredients, matched to the food database and saved per serving, so logging it adds one serving. Recipes are Trial and Paid . Having Tali read a recipe needs AI credits: Trial or Nutrition + AI Paid . On Free , Recipes shows "Recipes is on the Nutrition plan". My Recipes On Free

s: Import a recipe from a link
t: Import a recipe from a link # In your food log, tap Recipes at the bottom. Then tap + (or Import a Recipe if you have none). Under Paste a recipe link , paste the web address of the recipe. Tap Import Recipe . It reads the recipe data that most recipe sites publish for Google. Check the Recipe name and set Servings with the minus and plus buttons. Check each ingredient. Each shows Matched , Check match or No match . Tap an ingredient to Find a match and pick the right food. Fix grams if needed, or tap the bin to remove it. Per serving shows calories, protein, carbs and fat for one serving. Tap Save Recipe . Import Recipe If any ingredients have no match, you're asked whether to save anyway. Unmatched ingredients log as 0 calories.

s: When a link doesn't work: let Tali read it
t: When a link doesn't work: let Tali read it # Some pages don't publish recipe data. Then you'll see Let Tali read it (Nutrition + AI, uses 1 credit). Or tap Or paste the recipe text , paste the ingredients and method from anywhere (a website, an Instagram caption, your notes) and tap Let Tali cook (uses 1 credit). Tali turns it into the same review screen. If Tali can't find a recipe in it, no credit is used. Paste the recipe text for Tali

Log a recipe # Tap Log this recipe on its card. If you came from a meal it goes straight in, otherwise pick the meal. It logs one serving. The link icon opens the original recipe page, and the bin deletes the recipe.

Questions # Why did a recipe say some ingredients aren't matched? The importer couldn't find a close enough food. Tap the ingredient and search for the right one before saving. Can I log half a serving? Log it, then tap each food in your food log and halve the serving. Which sites work? Most recipe blogs and food sites. For anything else, paste the text and let Tali read it. Can the Nutrition plan import recipes? Yes, from links. Having Tali read a page or pasted text needs AI credits, which come with the trial and Nutrition + AI.

Can I log half a serving?
Can the Nutrition plan import recipes?

t: Tali is the assistant built into Totality Nutrition. She helps you log and plan, but she never logs or adds anything until you've checked it, and every calorie and macro number comes from the food database, not from the AI. Tali's protein tip on Home (Nutrition + AI)

What Tali does # Feature Where Cost Tell Tali what you ate Home, Add food Free (daily limit) Read a recipe from a page or pasted text Recipes, Import Recipe 1 credit (back if no recipe is found) Weekly summary of last week Insights 1 credit (re-opening is free) Plan your days Meal Plan 5 credits Protein tip Home calories card Free

Limits by plan # Credits Tell Tali per day Protein tip Free 0 3 No Nutrition Paid 0 3 No Trial 10 for the whole trial 5 Yes Nutrition + AI Paid 100 a month 50 Yes Credits on Nutrition + AI reset on the 1st of each month, Sydney time. Unused credits don't carry over. Trial credits don't reset.

See your credits # Open Settings and scroll to TALI AI . The card shows your plan, credits left ("86 of 100 credits left"), when they reset, and "Meals described today: 2 of 50". Nutrition + AI Trial Free: Tell Tali only If you're not on Nutrition + AI, the card has a See Nutrition + AI button that opens the plans screen.

When Tali can't help # "You've used this month's AI credits." Wait for the reset on the 1st, or move up from the trial to Nutrition + AI. "Tali is not included in your current plan." The feature needs credits. See Plans compared . "Tali needs a quick breather." You've made a lot of requests in a few minutes. Try again shortly. "Tali could not finish that one. No credits were used." Something went wrong on our side. Tap Try again . Tali says I'm good at the boring bits, like splitting your brekkie into foods or building a week of meals from what you already eat. You're still the boss though. Nothing goes in until you say so.

Questions # Does Tali give medical or diet advice? No. Tali works from your own logged data and targets. For anything about your health, see your GP or a dietitian. Can I buy more credits? Not separately in Nutrition. Nutrition + AI includes 100 a month. Does the Nutrition plan include Tali? It includes Tell Tali 3 times a day, the same as Free. Recipe reading, weekly summaries, meal plans by Tali and the protein tip are on Nutrition + AI (and the trial). Is Tali the same as in Totality? Yes, it's the same Tali. Credits in Nutrition come from your Nutrition plan.

Does the Nutrition plan include Tali?
Is Tali the same as in Totality?

t: Prices are in Australian dollars and there's no lock-in. On the web and Android you pay through Stripe. In the iPhone app you pay through Apple, at the price the App Store shows.

The plans # Free Trial 7 days Nutrition Nutrition + AI Price A$0 forever Free, no card A$8.99 a month or A$91.70 a year A$11.99 a month or A$122.30 a year Food logging, full history, targets, calculator Yes Yes Yes Yes Water, weight, measurements, photos, streaks Yes Yes Yes Yes Barcode scans 7 a week Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Saved meals Up to 10 Unlimited Unlimited Unlimited Tell Tali what you ate 3 a day 5 a day 3 a day 50 a day Insights and Breakdown No Yes Yes Yes Meal Plan and Grocery List No Yes Yes Yes Recipes (import from a link) No Yes Yes Yes Apple Health and Health Connect No Yes Yes Yes Tali credits (recipes, weekly summary, meal plans) No 10 for the trial No 100 a month Ads None None None None The yearly prices save 15% on twelve months.

The 7 day trial # Every new account starts with 7 days of the full Nutrition plan, with Tali's credits as shown above. It starts at your first Nutrition onboarding and needs no card. Two days before it ends you get a reminder email. When it ends, you move to Free unless you've picked a plan, and you get an email with the welcome offer. Nothing is deleted.

The welcome offer: 50% off # New subscribers get 50% off their first 2 months on a monthly plan, Nutrition or Nutrition + AI. It's applied automatically at checkout on the web and Android, no code needed. On the plans screen you'll see "Welcome offer: 50% off your first 2 months, applied at checkout". It applies to your first paid subscription, including straight after your trial. It doesn't apply to yearly plans, and it isn't combined with the Totality member price or a referral. Nutrition, monthly, with the welcome offer What's included
Referred by a friend # If you signed up with a friend's referral code, your first 2 monthly bills are 70% off (the 50% welcome offer plus 20% from the referral), applied at checkout.

Totality member price # If you pay for your own Totality coaching plan (as a trainer or gym owner), you get the Totality member price on Nutrition: A$4.49 a month or A$45.80 a year . The plans screen shows "Totality member price applied" and the lower prices on both plans. Being a client of a Totality gym or trainer doesn't count. See Using Nutrition with a Totality trainer . Totality member price applied

s: Look at the plans in the app
t: Look at the plans in the app # Open Settings , Subscription , Choose Nutrition or Nutrition + AI , or tap any See plans button. Pick Monthly or Yearly · Save 15% , then tap a plan card: Free , Nutrition or Nutrition + AI . Nutrition + AI Free, after the trial Yearly prices Plus Tali, your AI assistant

Questions # Which plan should I pick? If you want insights, meal plans, grocery lists and unlimited scans, Nutrition. If you also want Tali to read recipes, sum up your week and plan your meals, Nutrition + AI. If you just want to log food, Free is fine. Does the welcome offer work on yearly? No, it's monthly only. Is there a free trial of Nutrition + AI? The 7 day trial includes Tali's AI features with 10 credits. Are there ads on Free? No. No plan has ads.

Is there a free trial of Nutrition + AI?

t: You can subscribe from any See plans button or from Settings , Subscription . Billing works differently depending on where you pay.

s: Subscribe on the web or Android (Stripe)
t: Subscribe on the web or Android (Stripe) # Open the plans screen. Pick Monthly or Yearly · Save 15% . Tap Nutrition or Nutrition + AI . Tap Subscribe for $8.99/month (the button shows your plan's price). Stripe's secure checkout opens. Enter your card and pay. Any welcome offer, referral or member price is already applied. You come back to "Setting up your account…", then "You're subscribed!" and Home. During your trial you can subscribe early, or tap Continue with free trial to go back.

Subscribe on iPhone (Apple) # In the iPhone app, subscriptions are sold through Apple. The prices are the ones the App Store shows. If your Apple ID is eligible for Apple's introductory offer, the screen shows it, for example "Welcome offer: A$4.49/month for your first 2 months". Tap Subscribe , confirm with Apple, and you're in. Apple renews it automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Restore Purchases on the iPhone plans screen finds an existing subscription on your Apple ID, for example after reinstalling. The referral code box and the Totality member price aren't available on iPhone.

Change plan # Paid through Stripe: open the plans screen, tap the other plan and tap Switch to Nutrition + AI (or Switch to Nutrition ). It changes straight away on your existing subscription, and Stripe adjusts the price for the rest of the period. You'll see "Plan changed". Paid through Apple: change it in your iPhone's Settings , Apple ID, Subscriptions . A plan paid on the web can't be changed from the iPhone app, and an Apple plan can't be changed on the web. The screen tells you where to go. Settings while subscribed The plans screen while subscribed

Cancel # Open Settings and scroll to SUBSCRIPTION . Tap Manage Subscription . Web and Android: Stripe's billing page opens. Cancel your subscription there, or update your card or see invoices. iPhone (Apple billing): the App Store's subscriptions page opens. Cancel there. When you cancel through Stripe, your plan normally runs to the end of the period you've paid for. When the subscription ends you move to Free.

s: When a trial or plan ends
t: When a trial or plan ends # Trial ends: you move to Free . The plans screen says "Your trial has ended. You're on Free now." Your food history, targets, saved meals and everything else stay. Paid plan ends: you move to Free , with "Your subscription has ended" on the plans screen. Paid screens show a padlock again, but your data stays. Meals you saved past the Free limit of 10 still log. Payment fails (Stripe): you keep your plan for 14 days while Stripe retries. Settings shows Payment due , and the plans screen says "Your last payment didn't go through." Tap Update my card ; there's no need to subscribe again. If the card still fails, the plan ends and you move to Free. Settings on a trial Settings on Free

Questions # I paid but the app still says Free. Close the app fully and open it again. Paying can take a moment to reach your account. On iPhone, tap Restore Purchases . If it still says Free, email admintotality@gmail.com. Can I get a refund? See the refund policy at totality360.com.au/refund.html, or email admintotality@gmail.com. For Apple purchases, refunds go through Apple. Does deleting my account cancel my subscription? Cancel first to be safe. Use Manage Subscription in Settings before you delete. An Apple subscription is never cancelled by deleting your account; cancel it in the App Store, or you'll keep being charged. Where are my invoices? Web and Android: Manage Subscription opens Stripe's billing page with your invoices. iPhone: your App Store purchase history.

s: I paid but the app still says Free.
Does deleting my account cancel my subscription?

t: Open Settings with the gear icon at the top of Home. All of Settings is available on Free , Trial and Paid , except Refer & Earn, which isn't in the iPhone app. Settings
Your profile and account # The top card shows your photo (or initials), name and email. Tap the photo to choose a new one from your phone. ACCOUNT shows your Name and Email .

The sections, top to bottom # Section What it does Guide UNITS AND REGION Units, country, language, week start, clock Units and region CALORIE CYCLING More on training days, less on rest days Your targets ADAPTIVE NUTRITION Lowers today's target after an over day Your targets TARGETS Recalculate Targets opens the Calculator; Custom Targets lets you type your own Your targets SUBSCRIPTION Status (Active, Trial, Free or Payment due), plan, trial days left, Manage Subscription or Choose Nutrition or Nutrition + AI Subscribe, change, cancel Notifications Streak reminder and emails Below TALI AI Credits and meals described today Tali AI WEARABLES Connect a wearable Apple Health and Health Connect REFER & EARN Your referral code Below FOOD DATA SOURCES Credits and licences for AFCD and Open Food Facts ACCOUNT ACTIONS Sign Out and Delete Account Below Subscription and notifications Notifications and Tali AI

Notifications # Each switch saves straight away. Streak reminder at 7:30pm. A phone reminder when you haven't logged yet and your streak is on the line. Email notifications. Turns all non-essential emails on or off. The three below depend on it. Weekly recap email. A summary of your logging each week, sent Monday morning, if you logged that week. Tips and feature emails. Nutrition tips and new features, twice a month. All marketing emails. News and updates from Totality Nutrition. Emails about your account and billing, like trial reminders, always send.

Refer & Earn # Give 20%, get 20%. Tap Get my referral code , then Share my code . A friend who signs up with it gets 70% off their first 2 months on a monthly plan (the 50% welcome offer plus 20% from you). Once they subscribe, you get a recurring 20% off your own subscription, and it stacks with each friend, up to 5 referrals. The card counts Referred , Converted and Discounts active . Refer & Earn is on the web and Android, not in the iPhone app. Refer & Earn

s: Sign out and delete your account
t: Sign out and delete your account # Sign Out logs you out on that device. Delete Account permanently deletes your account and all your data. It can't be undone. You'll be asked to confirm. Cancel any subscription first: Manage Subscription for Stripe, or the App Store for Apple. Deleting your account doesn't cancel an Apple subscription. Account actions

t: Log in with your Totality login # Download Totality Nutrition, or open totalitynutrition.com.au. Tap Log In with the same email and password you use for Totality. Don't sign up again. Accept the terms if asked. Do the five onboarding steps. If you've already confirmed your units in Totality, they're filled in for you. Tap Get Started . If you've forgotten your password, use Forgot Password? on the log in screen. It resets the password for both apps.

p: Using Nutrition with a Totality trainer
t: What's shared both ways # Shared Notes Food log Food you log in Nutrition shows in your Totality food log, and your trainer sees it in your client profile. Food logged in Totality shows in Nutrition. Targets Targets your trainer sets in Totality show in Nutrition. Targets you save in Nutrition (onboarding, Calculator, Custom Targets) become your current targets in both. The most recent targets always win. Saved meals The same saved meals in both apps. Water Same entries and same daily target. Weight, measurements, progress photos Same history in both apps. Your trainer can see them in Totality. Wearable One connection for both apps. Heads up Finishing Nutrition onboarding saves a fresh set of targets dated today, and those become your current targets. If your trainer set your targets, check with them afterwards. They can set them again from Totality, or you can type theirs into Settings , Custom Targets .

t: Your Nutrition trial and plan # Your Nutrition 7 day trial starts at your first Nutrition onboarding , not when you joined Totality. Your gym or trainer's Totality plan doesn't include the Nutrition app's paid features. After the trial you move to Free unless you pick a Nutrition plan. Tali's limits in the Nutrition app come from your Nutrition plan. See Tali AI . The Totality member price (A$4.49 a month for Nutrition) is for people who pay for their own Totality plan, like trainers and gym owners. Clients of a Totality gym or trainer pay the normal price, and get the welcome offer instead.

t: Most problems are fixed by getting the latest version of the app. Work through the list below, and if you're still stuck, report it.

First, update the app # App updates arrive over the air. To pick one up: Open the app. Close it fully (swipe it away from your recent apps). Open it again. A fresh install still needs that one close and reopen. On the web, refresh the page.

Common problems # "We couldn't load your account. Check your connection, we'll keep trying." The app couldn't reach our server. It keeps retrying by itself; tap Try again once your connection is back. Your plan and data are safe. The app keeps retrying until it can load your account Paid screens are locked but I've paid. Close and reopen the app. On iPhone, tap Restore Purchases on the plans screen. Check Settings , Subscription shows Active. I can't log in. Check the email has no typo and try Forgot Password? . If it says to confirm your email, tap the link in the confirmation email first. Barcode scanner won't start. Allow camera access for the app in your phone's settings. On the web, type the barcode number instead. On Free, check you have scans left this week. A food's numbers look wrong. Tap Edit on the Per 100g card before adding it, or tap the food in your log afterwards to fix the numbers. Food log shows yesterday in the morning. It moves to the new day by itself when you come back to the screen. Tap the arrows if you're on a different day on purpose. Tali says "Tali needs a quick breather". You've made a lot of requests in a few minutes. Wait a few minutes and try again.

Report an issue # The purple ? button on most screens opens Report an Issue . Tap the purple ? button. Type a short Title . In Description , say what you did, what you expected and what happened. Pick a Priority : Low, Medium, High or Urgent. Tap Submit . You'll see "Ticket submitted. Our team will respond soon." Report an Issue You can also email admintotality@gmail.com.

Questions # Will reinstalling the app lose my data? No. Your logs, targets and history are on your account. Only favourites (stored on the device) and your dismissed "Connect a wearable" card are reset. The app looks different from this guide. Close and reopen it to get the latest update. Who sees my reports? The Totality team. Reports go straight to us.

No ads. What happens after my 7 day trial? You move to Free automatically. Nothing is charged and nothing is deleted. Pick a plan any time to get the paid features back. t: Logging food # Where does the food data come from? The Australian Food Composition Database (AFCD) from Food Standards Australia New Zealand, other government data, and Open Food Facts for packaged products. Each food shows its source. Does it work at Woolies and Coles? The barcode scanner looks up packaged products from Open Food Facts and foods other members have scanned. The Grocery List can also search Woolworths or Coles for an item. How many barcodes can I scan? 7 a week on Free (resetting Monday, Sydney time). Unlimited on the trial and paid plans. What if a food isn't in the database? Use Manual entry in Add food, or Tell Tali and pick the closest match. Can I log in kJ? Yes. Set Energy to kJ in Settings , Units and region . How far back can I go in the food log? The date arrows go 7 days back and 7 days ahead. Your full history is kept. How do I log the same breakfast every day? Save it as a saved meal with the star on the meal, or use Copy Yesterday . Can I star single foods? Yes. Tap the star on any food in Add food to keep it at the top as a favourite.

t: Tali # Who is Tali? The assistant inside Totality Nutrition. She can turn a described meal into foods, read recipes, write a weekly summary and plan your meals. See Tali AI . Does Tali make up calorie numbers? No. Calories and macros always come from the food database. Tali only works out which foods and how much. How many AI credits do I get? 10 for the whole trial, 100 a month on Nutrition + AI, none on Free or Nutrition. Tell Tali what you ate doesn't use credits.

t: Targets and health # How are my targets worked out? With the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, your activity and your goal. See Your targets . Can I use it while pregnant or breastfeeding? Yes. Choose your trimester or Breastfeeding in onboarding or the Calculator. There's no calorie deficit, protein comes first, and calories are a minimum. Check your targets with your GP, midwife or dietitian. Is this medical advice? No. Totality Nutrition is a tracking tool. Talk to a health professional before starting a new diet. How old do I need to be? You must be 18 or older to use Totality Nutrition.

t: Devices and account # Is there an iPhone app? The iPhone app is with Apple for review. In the meantime, use the web app in Safari at totalitynutrition.com.au. It's on Android and the web now. Can I use it on more than one device? Yes. Log in with the same email and password. Everything except favourites and a few on-device settings follows your account. Does it work with Apple Health or my watch? On iPhone, Apple Health. On Android, Health Connect, which brings in Samsung, Fitbit, Garmin, Pixel Watch and more. Trial and paid plans. See Apple Health and Health Connect . I use Totality with a trainer. Is this the same account? Yes. Log in with your Totality details. See Using Nutrition with a Totality trainer .
